_comment: CPU budgets in percent of ONE core for scripts/perf-farm-check.sh. Percent is (delta_jiffies / HZ) / window_seconds * 100 - a jiffie delta is NOT a percentage unless the window is exactly one second.

_phases.idle: Freshly launched instance, screen awake, no print. The floor.
_phases.print: Mock print with a deliberately long filename and animations ON. A short filename does not overflow its label, no scroll animation starts, and the regression this gate exists to catch is invisible.
_phases.print_anim_off: Same, animations OFF. The sharpest probe we have: with the preference off, any remaining per-frame animation is one that IGNORES it, which is the defect class of prestonbrown/helixscreen#1440. Should sit close to the short-filename floor.

_calibration: Measured on the K1C 2026-09-04 against the UNFIXED 0.99.117 build: idle 6.5, print 26.4, print-off 20.5, and a short-filename print 12.5. The print-off budget is set BELOW the unfixed 20.5 deliberately, so this gate fails on a build carrying that defect. Recalibrate every budget from a fixed build before treating a pass as meaningful.

devices.name: k1c
devices.note: Ingenic XBurst II MIPS32, 2 cores, 256 MB. No SIMD blend path, draw loop at -Os, framebuffer is 32bpp so LV_COLOR_DEPTH 16 never applies. Shares its CPU with Klipper. Dropbear 2019.78 needs an RSA key.

devices.name: ad5m
devices.note: Cortex-A7 with NEON, 110 MB - the tightest box in the fleet on memory. Klipper Mod install with no init script, so service_stop/start are unknown and it is measured idle only until its supervisor is identified. Finding that is the one thing that would complete this gate's coverage.

devices.name: cc1
devices.note: Elegoo Centauri Carbon, armv7, 112 MB and already swapping at idle. Mocks are compiled OUT of this build (mk/cross.mk ENABLE_MOCKS := no), so the script detects their absence and measures idle only. BusyBox here rejects 'head -c' and bare 'head -N'.
